ja.useTitle: 写真を受け取る業務へ。
ja.useLead: 写真だけを受け取る流れに、原本と結び付いた撮影記録を加える。まず一つの業務を選び、既存の確認手順と併用する評価を考えます。
usecases: 写真と証跡の整合性や、登録鍵・時刻の確認結果を、担当者が参照できる材料にします。保険金支払いの判断は既存の審査と分けて扱います。
点検写真の原本と対応する証跡を保存し、引き継ぎ後にも確認できる形を検討します。撮影対象や点検内容の正確さは別途確認します。
法務・監査・記録管理
誰が何を受け取り、どの版・どの条件で検証したかを残す運用へ。共有権限、保存期間、個人情報の扱いも一緒に設計します。
ja.useNote: 上記は導入を検討するための用途例です。顧客の採用実績や、損害・不正を防止した実績を示すものではありません。
ja.verifyTitle: 確認できることを、切り分ける。
ja.verifyLead: 証跡が正しくても、写真の内容が正しいとは限りません。検証条件を満たした項目と、別の確認が必要な項目を一緒に表示することが重要です。

タイムスタンプ

登録された鍵

検証の結論
対象の版・入力・信頼条件における確認済み／未確認／不一致。
法的な証拠採用、保険金支払いの可否、完全適合や独立監査の成立。
ja.verifyNote: 上記は受領側で評価する項目です。VeraCheck Webのβビューアが、これらをすべて検証するという意味ではありません。

ja.keyNote: 一般向けアプリで撮影しただけでは、保険会社に端末鍵が登録されたことにはなりません。SDKでは未知の鍵の証跡は、署名とタイムスタンプが正しくても「部分的な検証」に留まります。

ja.evaluationTitle: 一つの業務で、小さく評価する。
ja.evaluationLead: 本番データを集める前に、対象と成功条件を決めます。結果が不明なケースも、業務でどう扱うかまで確認します。
steps: 対象を決める
例えば、損害写真の受付一工程。提出する人、受領担当者、現状の確認方法を整理します。
試験データで一巡する
合成データや利用権限のある試験写真で、撮影・原本保存・証跡受領・検証を試します。
失敗と未確認も確認する
ファイル変更、未知の鍵、時刻証拠不足などを含め、業務判断に使える結果表示かを評価します。
導入条件を合意する
利用許諾、データの保存先、閲覧権限、保管期間、費用、支援範囲を個別に確認します。
ja.faqTitle: 導入検討でよくある質問
faq: AI生成画像や保険金不正を、自動で判定できますか？
画像の内容が真実か、不正があるかを自動で保証する製品ではありません。署名やハッシュ、時刻証拠、登録鍵の確認結果を、他の調査材料と組み合わせて使います。
既存の保険会社アプリに、そのまま組み込めますか？
受領側のVerify SDKは公開alpha版として評価できます。撮影機能を組み込むCapture SDKは設計段階です。既存アプリへの接続、鍵の登録、運用条件は個別に検討します。
法人での利用条件はどう確認しますか？
公開アプリのEULAには個人・非商業利用に関する記載があります。法人利用の可否・許諾条件は事前に窓口で確認してください。Verify SDKのApache-2.0ライセンスと、アプリの利用許諾は別です。
ブラウザーで証拠パックを開けば、すべて検証できますか？
VeraCheck Webは表示と限定的なチェックを行うβビューアです。Merkle証明やTSA情報の存在表示は、その暗号学的な完全検証とは異なります。検証器の版、対応項目、未確認項目を確認してください。

ja.contactLead: 対象業務、撮影する人、受領方法、確かめたいことをお知らせください。アプリの評価か、SDKの接続評価かを分けて、必要な確認事項を整理します。

en.title: VeraSnap for Businesses & Insurers | Photo Evidence & Verify SDK | VSO
en.description: Evaluate capture records for claims photos, loss assessment and field inspections. VSO links to the VeraSnap apps, Verify SDK, evaluation steps and verification limits.
en.headline: Receive photos with capture records you can check.
en.lead: Insurance claims, loss assessment and field inspections. Bring the evidence recorded alongside VeraSnap photos into the receiving team's review process. Find the entry points for evaluating the app and server-side SDK verification.
en.heroNote: Official VSO guide · Provided by VeritasChain Co., Ltd.
diagram: Separate checks in the receiving system
en.diagramCaption: A conceptual workflow for an integration discussion. This is not an actual verification-results screen or a deployed customer case.
en.useTitle: Start with the workflow that receives the photos.
en.useLead: Add capture records bound to the original files to an existing photo-submission process. Choose one workflow first and evaluate it alongside your current review procedures.
usecases: Give reviewers file-and-evidence consistency checks, enrolled-key results and timestamp findings as additional material. Keep claim-payment decisions within the existing assessment process.
Consider how to retain original inspection photos and their corresponding evidence for later checks. The subject photographed and the accuracy of the inspection still need separate review.
Record who received what, which version was used for verification and under what conditions. Design access permissions, retention periods and personal-data handling alongside the workflow.
en.useNote: These are potential evaluation use cases. They do not represent customer deployments or demonstrated reductions in loss or fraud.
en.verifyLead: Valid evidence does not necessarily mean the content of a photo is true. Show which checks met their conditions and which questions still require separate review.
en.tableLabel: Verification scope and limitations. Scroll horizontally on smaller screens
rows: File and signature
Whether the submitted photo matches the evidence hash and the signature can be verified.
The truth of the scene, its state before editing, or whether the capture was authorized.
Timestamp
The binding between the relevant data and timestamp evidence from a trusted TSA.
The absolute accuracy of the capture time recorded by the device.
Enrolled key
Whether the verified device-key enrollment record corresponds to the signing key.
The photographer's identity, the accuracy of the claim or the capture location.
Verification conclusion
Verified, unverified and inconsistent items for the selected version, inputs and trust conditions.
Admissibility as legal evidence, a claim-payment decision, full conformance or an independent audit.
en.verifyNote: These are items for the receiving organization to evaluate. This does not mean the VeraCheck Web beta viewer verifies all of them.
en.choiceTitle: Evaluate the app. Assess integration with the SDK.
en.choiceLead: Treat capture-and-sharing usability and integration of verification into a receiving system as separate evaluation stages.
choices: Use the official iOS and Android store listings to explore capture and evidence handling. Check OS and version differences, and business-use terms, before adoption.
A Python SDK for receiving photos and evidence. Evaluate signature, timestamp-evidence and key-enrollment checks. Its API may change, and it has not been independently audited.
Read current SDK guidance and limitations
en.keyNote: Taking a photo with the consumer app does not enroll the device key with an insurer. In the SDK, evidence from an unknown key remains partially verified even when the signature and timestamp are valid.
en.captureNote: The Capture SDK for embedding capture functionality in a company's own app is at the design stage. It is separate from the published Verify SDK.
en.linksLead: Choose a product page, app or verification resource for your purpose. Check app versions and SDK availability with their respective publishers.
links: Explore its potential use in receiving and reviewing insurance photos.
Review app features, screen examples and usage guidance.
Check available versions, supported devices and terms of use.
Check Android availability and data-handling information.
Check the commit to evaluate, key enrollment, verification outcomes and known limitations.
View evidence packs and run limited checks. It is not a complete Merkle/TSA verifier.
Read about CPP, the evidence structure, historical updates and limitations.
Terms of use and evaluation conditions
Review the app's terms. Contact the team to confirm business-use conditions.
App and SDK licenses are separate
en.evaluationTitle: Evaluate one workflow on a small scale.
en.evaluationLead: Define the scope and success criteria before collecting production data. Include how your workflow will handle unknown results.
steps: Choose the scope
For example, one step in receiving loss photos. Identify the submitter, receiving reviewer and current review method.
Run through with test data
Use synthetic data or test photos you are authorized to use to evaluate capture, original-file retention, evidence receipt and verification.
Include failures and unverified items
Evaluate whether the results are useful for operational decisions, including altered files, unknown keys and missing timestamp evidence.
Agree on adoption conditions
Confirm licensing, storage locations, access permissions, retention periods, costs and support scope individually.
faq: Can it automatically identify AI-generated images or insurance fraud?

The product does not guarantee that image content is true or automatically establish whether fraud occurred. Use signature, hash, timestamp-evidence and enrolled-key findings alongside other investigative material.
Can it be embedded directly in an insurer's existing app?

The receiving-side Verify SDK is available for evaluation as a public alpha. The Capture SDK for embedded capture functionality is at the design stage. Integration, key enrollment and operational conditions require separate consideration.
How do we confirm business-use terms?

The public app EULA contains provisions about personal and non-commercial use. Confirm business-use permission and licensing conditions with the team in advance. The Verify SDK's Apache-2.0 license is separate from the app license.
Does opening an evidence pack in a browser verify everything?

VeraCheck Web is a beta viewer for display and limited checks. Showing that Merkle proof or TSA information is present is different from fully verifying it cryptographically. Check the verifier version, supported checks and unverified items.
en.contactTitle: Let's map the workflow that receives your photos.
en.contactLead: Tell us the workflow, who takes the photos, how you receive them and what you need to check. We can separate app evaluation from SDK integration assessment and identify the questions to resolve.
en.contactCta: Contact us for a business or insurer evaluation
en.mailSubject: VeraSnap evaluation inquiry for a business or insurer
en.contactNote: You do not need to attach confidential data such as claim documents, patient information or credentials to your first inquiry.
en.status: VeraSnap is a first-party app; Verify SDK is a first-party alpha. The current SDK README points to commit 5b19884, which includes a key re-enrollment fix. The fixed v0.1.0 release does not contain this later repair. Successful first-party tests and CI do not establish an independent audit or independent third-party reproduction.
en.researchStatus: CPP's full conformance with VAP has not been established. VAP/VCP experimental extensions remain unadopted; independent third-party reproduction has not been established.

zh.headline: 让收到的照片，附有可核验的拍摄记录。
zh.lead: 保险理赔、损失查勘、现场检查。将VeraSnap随照片保留的证据，接入接收方的审核流程。本页汇总从应用评估到服务器端SDK验证所需的入口。

zh.useTitle: 从接收照片的业务流程入手。
zh.useLead: 在现有照片提交流程中，加入与原始文件绑定的拍摄记录。先选定一项业务，再评估如何与现有审核步骤配合使用。
usecases: 将照片与证据的一致性、登记密钥及时间戳的核验结果，作为审核人员的参考材料。是否支付赔款仍应按现有理赔审核流程判断。
探索如何保存检查照片的原始文件及对应证据，以便交接后再次核验。拍摄对象及检查内容是否准确，仍需另行确认。
记录谁接收了什么，以及使用哪个版本、在什么条件下进行验证。同时设计共享权限、保管期限和个人信息处理方式。

可信时间戳机构（TSA）的时间证据与目标数据之间的绑定关系。

法律上的证据可采性、是否支付赔款、完全符合规范，或已完成独立审计。

steps: 确定评估范围
例如，损失照片接收流程中的一个环节。明确提交者、接收审核人员和现有核查方式。

分别确认许可、数据保存位置、访问权限、保管期限、费用和支持范围。
faq: 能自动识别AI生成图像或保险欺诈吗？
本产品不保证图像内容真实，也不自动认定是否存在欺诈。应将签名、哈希、时间证据和登记密钥的核验结果，与其他调查材料结合使用。
能直接嵌入保险公司现有的应用吗？
接收方的Verify SDK可作为公开alpha版进行评估。用于嵌入拍摄功能的Capture SDK仍在设计阶段。既有应用的接入、密钥登记及运行条件需另行评估。
如何确认企业使用条件？
公开应用的EULA中包含个人及非商业使用相关条款。企业使用是否获准以及许可条件，请提前联系我们确认。Verify SDK的Apache-2.0许可与应用的使用许可是两回事。
在浏览器中打开证据包，就能验证全部内容吗？
VeraCheck Web是用于展示和有限检查的β版查看器。显示存在Merkle证明或TSA信息，不等于完成其密码学验证。请确认验证器版本、支持的检查项目及尚未验证的事项。
